key_insight: Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) and Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA) were used to tune SMAW parameters for better weld bead geometry prediction and optimization.
engineering_relevance: Improving weld bead geometry helps control joint quality and can directly influence the mechanical and microstructural performance of welded components.
method: Optimize shielded metal arc welding process parameters
Compare WOA and GOA against prior regression-based D-optimal results
Evaluate predicted bead geometry against experimental measurements
evidence_signal: The abstract reports low prediction error, with 0.22% for WOA and 0.28% for GOA, both better than the earlier regression model error of 0.51%.
watch_item: Results are based on a specific dataset and welding setup, so the reported gains may not transfer directly to other materials, joints, or process conditions.
paper_title: Parameter optimization of shielded metal arc welding process on weld bead geometry using whale optimization algorithm and grasshopper optimization algorithm
